title: Leading climate action: trees, drains, talks and your 90-day plan

say: Leading climate action: trees, drains, talks and your 90-day plan.
This is the video for module three of Climate Awareness and Community Resilience.
Some of the best climate actions are also the oldest: caring for trees and keeping water flowing. A tree shades a compound today and takes carbon dioxide out of the air as it grows.

say: Choose the right tree for your zone and purpose: shade, fruit or erosion control. Ask a local nursery or the state forestry office.

say: Plant at the start of the rainy season, once the soil is properly moist, so roots establish before the dry season.

say: Dig a hole about twice as wide as the root ball. Remove the polythene bag carefully, set the seedling at the same depth, press firmly and water well.

say: After three months, 42 are alive. 42 divided by 60, times 100, is a 70% survival rate. Most losses were next to the football field, where children trampled them.
Replacing 18 trees costs about 5,400 naira. So they add stick rings on that side, and aim for at least 85% survival.

say: In towns, much flooding happens because drains are blocked with plastic bags and bottles. Clear them before the heavy rains. Talk to your LGA sanitation office first. They may lend tools and collect the waste.
Wear thick gloves and boots, cover cuts, and wash your hands well with soap afterwards.

panel.heading: A safe drain clean-up
left: Talk to the LGA sanitation office first
right: Enter a drain when water is flowing

say: Never let children help in drains. Never enter a drain during rain or when water is flowing. And never burn the waste, because burning plastic gives off harmful smoke.

say: Zainab has ten minutes at her market women's meeting in Kaduna. She starts with what people have seen: who remembers when the rains started in April? This year we waited until May.

say: She explains the cause simply, then what it means in the market: hotter afternoons. She shows the heat danger signs.

say: After questions, she makes one clear ask: write your name here if you will check on one older trader in the next hot spell. Eleven members sign up.
If someone says it is just a bad year, do not argue. Say, let us check our records.

say: Partners include the LGA, the State Ministry of Environment, extension workers, the health centre and NiMet. Make your request small and specific. For example, we planted 60 trees and 42 survived. Can your office supply 20 replacement seedlings before 15 May?
Be careful of anyone who asks your group to pay a fee for climate grants. Genuine agencies do not ask for payment through personal accounts.

panel.heading: A request partners can say yes to
items: Who your group is, in one sentence
What you have already done, with numbers
Exactly what you need, and by when
What you will do in return
A contact name, and follow up in a week

say: Rahila sells pepper and tomatoes in Lafia. Her top vulnerability was income. She raised her stock on a wooden platform and set up a heat rota for 9 older traders.

items: Practice: raised stock and a heat rota

After: no stock lost in 3 heavy rains
Rota: 96 of 108 checks made, about 89%
Income score: down from 9 to 7

say: To remember. Care for trees after planting. Clear drains safely. Start every talk from what people have seen. Make small, specific requests. And report your results honestly, including what went wrong.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Plant at early rains, protect, give each tree a caretaker
Clear drains safely and never burn the waste
Start talks from what people have seen
Make small, specific, dated requests
Report before and after, including what went wrong
